integrity: Proof is analytic and endpoint extremizers are explicit probability laws. Exact rational enumeration is supplementary. Historical priority has not been independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for one-sided six-sample cutoff and fair pairwise-independent ranked signs conditional on all observed magnitudes; no bound claimed under merely marginal symmetry and pairwise independence without conditional sign assumptions.
title: Sharp six-sample Wilcoxon size under pairwise-independent ranked signs
